latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the ecommerce-visual-copywriting skill.
- Provides a full SOP for designing visual copy (main image + detail page) for e-commerce products.
- Built-in compliance rules covering major categories (health supplements, sports equipment, food) tailored for major Chinese platforms.
- Includes a self-review scoring system; only outputs if the compliance score ≥80.
- Modular workflow: collects inputs, extracts key selling points, requires user confirmation, then outputs structured, compliant image and copy plans for designers.
- Supports Markdown output and is suitable for artifact delivery.
